name: Custom Save Folders
description: Use separate save folders automatically for specific games, profiles, or selected mods.

ui.title: Custom Save Folders
ui.help_tooltip: Show how custom save folders are selected
ui.help_body:
What this plugin changes
The plugin temporarily writes a different save-folder name into the game's DATA file before launch. After the game closes, G3M restores the original DATA file from backup. It does not delete save folders on disk.

Folders
A folder entry is a save-folder name for one game. Global folders work in every profile. Profile folders work only in that profile. Drag folders to change fallback priority.

Folder enabled state
An enabled folder can be used as a fallback when no mod rule wins. A disabled folder is skipped by fallback selection.

Mod rules
A rule connects one profile mod to one folder from the same game. On launch, enabled rules are checked from top to bottom. The first enabled rule whose mod is currently selected and active in the launched profile wins.

Rule priority over folder enabled state
A matching enabled rule can still use its linked folder even if that folder is disabled in the folders list. This lets you keep a folder unavailable as a general fallback while still forcing it for one specific mod.

If no rule matches
G3M uses the first enabled folder that matches the launched game and active profile. If there is no matching enabled rule and no matching enabled folder, nothing is applied.

Broken rules
A missing mod or missing folder is shown in the rules list and ignored during launch. If the mod is installed again with the same ID, the rule starts working again. You can also delete the broken rule manually.

Shortcuts
Shortcuts freeze the resolved folder when the shortcut is created. Changing rules later does not change existing shortcuts. Create a new shortcut if you want it to use the new rules.
